commit.message:
Port the Android globe geohash picker to iOS (#1807)

* Port the Android globe geohash picker to iOS

Adds the 3D globe picker from bitchat-android: a map button next to the
geohash field opens a full-screen orthographic globe (Natural Earth land,
borders and cities, geohash grid, crosshair) with drag/fling, pinch, tap
and double-tap, precision buttons and a fly-in to the current geohash.
Selecting teleports like typing a geohash.

Beyond a straight port:
- Fix ocean painted as land: the point-in-ring test counted the
  antimeridian seam as a crossing for Eurasia, flipping its fill over the
  Pacific and Atlantic. Android has the same bug.
- Motion detail only steps down within one gesture, so layers no longer
  flash on and off while dragging.
- The geohash grid and city dots draw at every detail level instead of
  vanishing while the globe moves.

Extracts GeohashCoverage so the sheet and picker share the cell-size
string, and adds the picker strings in all locales.

* Let the globe reach polar targets past the drag limit

A polar cell's center can lie past the ±89° drag limit (zzzz is at
89.91°). The animated intro clamped its latitude there and selected
zzzf, while the Reduce Motion path kept zzzz. Animations now always
reach their target; dragging keeps the limit on the far side and never
snaps a polar view back to it.
